description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art girl with green hair in long high twin tails: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask, on the forehead of the figure seen from the front: replace the straight-cut bangs with natural everyday bangs, like ordinary hair: a few soft locks falling from a side parting and swept a little to one side, each lock a different length with a tapered pointed tip, a little forehead showing between the locks, the tips stopping just above the eyes, never a straight horizontal edge. The same bright grass green as the hair above, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. Do not change the eyes, the face below them, the long pointed ears, the twin tails, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
